headline: Electrical upgrades to Holyoke flood pump stations, plus a pavilion at 431 West Cherry Street.
summary: Trail restoration at Mt. Tom State Reservation and grading and fill along the bank at 5 Appleton Street are on the list. Updates on the 233 Easthampton Road restoration plan and strategic planning for 2027 are also planned.
items: Holyoke Revolver Club request for a determination of applicability for an 85 x 15' pavilion at 431 West Cherry Street (MBP: 200-00-002)
MA Department of Conservation and Recreation extension permit for trail restoration and improvements at Mt. Tom State Reservation (MBP 224-00-001)
City of Holyoke Engineering Department notice of intent, continued from 10/08/26, for electrical upgrades, sluice gate actuator replacements, and building envelope repairs at multiple sites
Enforcement order, continued from 10/08/26, for grading and fill along about 470 lineal feet of banks at 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006)
Discussion of the 233 Easthampton Road restoration plan update
Discussion of Conservation Commission strategic planning for 2027
Discussion of upcoming items for the 11/12/26 meeting

# Holyoke Conservation Commission

Received: OCT 19 2026 (Holyoke City Clerk)

**October 22nd, 2026**
**6:15 PM**

**This meeting will be held remotely, in accordance with temporary changes to Open Meeting Law. Access to this meeting is available to the public by computer or phone as follows:**

- Computer Access: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89934115730?pwd=Lub32w5G4BBZZqiea7r4wDj3ZRPl0e.1
- Phone Access: Call +1 309-205-3325 and enter the Meeting ID followed by: 895 2116 5144

Contact Sean Mullen for questions about meeting access: mullens@holyoke.org or 413-322-5610

(All meetings are recorded)

1. Call to Order
2. Request for Determination of Applicability
   - Applicant: Holyoke Revolver Club
   - Location: 431 West Cherry Street ( MBP: 200-00-002)
   - Description: Construction of a 85 x 15' pavilion on existing slab. 900 SF is within the Buffer Zone. Wetland delineation was documented under prior RDA in 2024. Work involves removal of existing concrete, installing of 10 sono-tubes to support pavilion, pouring of new concrete floor, construction of pavilion. Work anticipated to occur November-April 2026 to avoid rare species conflicts.
3. Extension Permit for Orders of Conditions
   - Applicant: MA Department of Conservation and Recreation
   - Location: Mt. Tom State Reservation (MBP 224-00-001)
   - Description: Trail restoration and improvements within Riverfront and Buffer Zone of Bordering Vegetated Wetlands
4. Notice of Intent – Continued from 10/08/26
   - Applicant: City of Holyoke, Engineering Department
   - Representative: Tighe and Bond
   - Location: Multiple Sites
   - Description: The proposed project includes electrical upgrades to the existing Flood Pump Stations #1 through #7, sluice gate actuator replacements at Tailrace Structure #6 and the Tailrace Intake and Gatehouse Structures #24, as well as limited building envelope repairs at Flood Pump Stations #5 through #7
5. Enforcement Order – Continued from 10/08/26
   - Location: 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006)
   - Description: Grading and fill deposition along approximately 470 lineal feet of banks within Riverfront, Banks, and Priority and Estimated Habitats of Rare Species associated with the Connecticut River. Fill sediments and associated debris were observed eroding down the steep bank towards the water.
6. Discussion – 233 Easthampton Road Restoration Plan Update
7. Discussion – Conservation Commission Strategic Planning for 2027
8. Formal Vote – Minutes from 8/13/26, 8/27/26, 9/24/26, and 10/08/26 meetings
9. Discussion – Upcoming Items for 11/12/26 Meeting
10. Mail/other items not reasonably anticipated by the Chair
11. Adjourn
